findings.problem: The finite validator approximates the frozen UTC regex with ends_with('Z') plus chrono RFC3339 parsing, admitting a space separator that the frozen literal T grammar forbids.
findings.actualCounterexample: Complete otherwise valid CreateProjectCompletionRecordRequest with completedAt=2026-11-06 12:00:00Z normalizes successfully; expected rejection from frozen UTC pattern.
findings.scopeOfActualFailure: The first space-separator case failed. Lowercase t and leap-second cases were not reached and are not claimed independently reproduced.
findings.minimumCorrection: Match the registered datetime grammar exactly (literal T, UTC Z, bounded HH:MM:SS with seconds below 60 and actual calendar date), preserving accepted fractional precision. Do not relax the frozen regex.
